status_legend.summary: The capability is proven in the legacy reference surface, but Kain does not yet own a meaningful implementation seam.
Kain has registries, projections, or shell placeholders for the capability, but the behavior is still materially below parity.
Kain has a working proof in a non-flagship lane or a bounded lab, but the flagship native app is not yet the semantic owner.
The flagship native lane owns a real implementation seam, but the delivered behavior is still narrower than the parity baseline.
The capability is Kain-owned and currently covered by a concrete validation hook or shipped proof surface.

baselines.label: KSculpt Baseline
baselines.summary: Mesh sculpting, projected cursor feedback, symmetry, topology workflows, layers, material preview, and export expectations come from the KSculpt reference suite.

baselines.label: KPainter Baseline
baselines.summary: Painter parity is composite: Graphos defines the legacy feature surface while the current Kain painter scaffolds provide the strongest in-repo implementation seams.

capabilities.label: Native desktop dev loop
capabilities.summary: One-command native app materialization, watch, hot reload, restart fallback, and operator-visible reload outcomes.

reference_sources.feature: Desktop-grade hot reload for large native tools.

capabilities.gap_summary: The loop is real, but host stability still depends on the current qmlscene-backed launcher path.

capabilities.label: Shared DCC workbench shell
capabilities.summary: One flagship native shell with workspace modes, docked chrome, commands, tools, and persistent layout semantics.

reference_sources.feature: Unified desktop shell that can host flagship DCC tools.

capabilities.gap_summary: The shell and manifests exist, but sculpt and painter behavior are still shallower than the reference apps.

capabilities.label: Session restore and reload-safe state
capabilities.summary: Persisted session, runtime snapshot, and workbench state that survive hot reloads and restart fallbacks.

reference_sources.feature: Large tools must feel stateful during native hot reload.

capabilities.gap_summary: The contracts exist, but artist-facing workspace/session restore scenarios still need dedicated acceptance coverage.

capabilities.label: Durable asset and export receipts
capabilities.summary: Typed import, export, and lineage receipts shared across sculpt meshes, texture sets, captures, and packed outputs.

reference_sources.feature: Native apps should own real asset workflows rather than throwaway demos.

validation_hooks: manual:asset and export receipt schema review
capabilities.gap_summary: Receipts exist for several lanes, but there is no single parity-backed contract across sculpt, painter, and capture workflows yet.

capabilities.label: Parity matrix and validation harness
capabilities.summary: Machine-readable feature inventory that maps each parity claim to a reference source, Kain owner, status, and validation hook.

reference_sources.feature: Kain should be able to own apps of the same magnitude as the reference suite.

capabilities.gap_summary: The matrix now exists, but scenario-level acceptance automation still needs to grow around it.

capabilities.label: Projected sculpt cursor
capabilities.summary: Projected cursor and mirrored symmetry cursor feedback on the active sculpt target.

reference_sources.feature: Projected cursor and mirrored sculpt cursor.

capabilities.gap_summary: The flagship sculpt lane does not yet own real projected cursor feedback on mesh surfaces.

capabilities.label: Sculpt brush preset registry
capabilities.summary: Registry-owned sculpt tools, radius, intensity, falloff, invert behavior, and preset selection.

reference_sources.feature: Brush menu, radius, intensity, symmetry, and preset switching.

capabilities.gap_summary: The registry seam exists, but the flagship sculpt runtime still lacks reference-depth preset and stroke behavior.

capabilities.label: Sculpt symmetry modes
capabilities.summary: Symmetry-aware sculpt strokes and mirrored cursor posture.
capabilities.gap_summary: There is no explicit shared symmetry contract yet for the flagship native sculpt lane.

capabilities.label: Topology-aware sculpt edit targets
capabilities.summary: Stable mesh resource ids, active edit targets, and reducer-owned topology lineage for sculpt sessions.

reference_sources.feature: Active sculpt target and viewport tool state.
Topology and mesh ownership for sculpt evaluation.

capabilities.gap_summary: The edit-target contract exists, but the sculpt runtime still does not reach KSculpt-level surface ownership.

capabilities.label: Dynamic topology and remesh workflows
capabilities.summary: Topology rebuild, remesh, and detail-control workflows for sculpt sessions.

reference_sources.feature: Dynamic topology, topology rebuild, and Rust sculpt manager.
Dynamic topology controls and voxel or remesh behavior.

capabilities.gap_summary: Topology services and tools are staged, but the flagship sculpt lane is still below production mesh-sculpt depth.

capabilities.label: Sculpt layers and material preview
capabilities.summary: Non-destructive sculpt strata, clay or PBR preview posture, and matcap-style look switching.
capabilities.gap_summary: The preview and panel seams exist, but there is no real sculpt-layer or matcap parity yet.

capabilities.label: Sculpt transform posture and export
capabilities.summary: Transform or gizmo posture over sculpt targets plus geometry export receipts.
capabilities.gap_summary: Gizmo and export seams are real, but the flagship sculpt lane still lacks end-to-end KSculpt-grade export behavior.

capabilities.label: Layered paint stack
capabilities.summary: Layer ordering, visibility, opacity, and paint-session structure for the flagship painter lane.

reference_sources.feature: Painter layer list, visibility, opacity, and delete flow.

capabilities.gap_summary: Kain has a real layer prototype in the Node-first painter lane, but the flagship native painter lane does not yet own it.

capabilities.label: Material channel authoring
capabilities.summary: Texture-set and channel-aware painting across albedo, normal, roughness, metalness, and emission surfaces.
capabilities.gap_summary: The material lane owns channel-oriented receipts, but it is not yet a native painter runtime with live authoring semantics.

capabilities.label: Alpha maps and painter brush presets
capabilities.summary: Painter brush presets, alpha maps, spacing, erase behavior, and brush-level controls.

reference_sources.feature: Alpha import and custom brush saving.
Brush settings, spacing, angle, jitter, and erase.

capabilities.gap_summary: The Node-first painter prototype proves brush preset seams, but flagship native parity is still missing.

capabilities.label: Painter symmetry modes
capabilities.summary: 2D and 3D-aware symmetry for paint strokes, including X, Y, and radial variants.

reference_sources.feature: Painter symmetry modes including NONE, X, Y, and RADIAL.

capabilities.gap_summary: There is no dedicated parity-grade painter symmetry contract in the flagship native lane.

capabilities.label: Painter generators and filters
capabilities.summary: Registry-owned generators and filters such as noise, patterns, blur, levels, normal conversion, and posterize-style transforms.

reference_sources.feature: Painter engine filter and generator application.

capabilities.gap_summary: Generator and filter seams exist in the material lane, but they are not yet exposed as a parity-grade native painter surface.

capabilities.label: Painter simulation effects
capabilities.summary: Simulation-style paint effects such as drip, bleed, liquify, wind, vortex, erosion, or datamosh-style passes.

reference_sources.feature: Simulation effect family on paint data.

capabilities.gap_summary: The flagship painter lane does not yet own simulation-style paint effects.

capabilities.label: Live 3D painter preview
capabilities.summary: 3D preview mode that binds current painter outputs to a preview material and updates as the artist works.
capabilities.gap_summary: Kain has preview proofs, but the flagship native painter lane still needs a unified preview material contract.

capabilities.label: Packed texture export
capabilities.summary: Packed texture-set export receipts and repeatable export presets for the painter or lookdev lane.
capabilities.gap_summary: The export receipt seam is real, but it is still lookdev-oriented rather than full KPainter parity.

capabilities.label: Painter timeline and playback
capabilities.summary: Timeline, playback, keyframes, and parameter animation for advanced painter behaviors.
capabilities.gap_summary: The flagship painter lane has no dedicated timeline or playback contract yet.
